# Source of the stamp lists

`public-resolvers.md` and `relays.md` are `v3/public-resolvers.md` and `v3/relays.md` of
<https://github.com/DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-resolvers>, commit `ec9e42146e26ce85486e063aaf07e0f97cccf24f` (committed
2026-11-12), copied on 2026-11-13, unchanged (the `.minisig` files left out). The counts in `../../stamps.rs` are
those of these copies.
